SPARK & the Web4 Sovereignty LoopSPARK 与 Web4 主权回路

Four open-source organs — Vault, Engine, Aether, Havix — form one closed circuit, and SPARK is the fuel that makes it turn. This document describes the architecture as built, the token economics as designed, and the dual-track launch: a whitelisted presale followed by a public LBP-based IDO. 四个开源器官 —— Vault、Engine、Aether、Havix —— 组成一条闭合回路，SPARK 是让它转动起来的燃料。本文档记录已建成的架构、已设计的代币经济，以及双轨发行：白名单预售之后的公开 LBP 式 IDO。

Abstract. Web3 gave users wallets but kept their social lives on servers. The Web4 prototype loop closes that gap with physical isolation: an online social app (Engine) that holds no keys, an offline safe (Vault) that holds keys and never connects, an SBT-governed parliament (Aether) that banks the fuel reserve, and a P2P substrate (Havix) that charters AI stewards under a living constitution. $SPARK is the single issued asset that meters expression in the app, endows the DAO reserve, and flows between them — fuel for the loop, never a vote. This whitepaper documents the architecture as it exists in the public repositories, then specifies the token: utility, allocation (10% presale / 30% IDO / 10% DEX liquidity / 50% DAO reserve), the two-phase launch, the unlock schedule, and the safeguards that keep the launch fair and the reserve sovereign. 摘要。Web3 给了用户钱包，却把他们的社交生活留在服务器上。Web4 原型回路以物理隔离弥合这一缺口：不持有任何密钥的在线社交应用（Engine）、持有密钥且永不联网的离线保险箱（Vault）、以 SBT 治理收储燃料储备的议会（Aether）、以及在一部活的宪章之下为 AI 管家颁授执照的 P2P 基座（Havix）。$SPARK 是唯一发行的资产：它在应用中计量表达、为 DAO 储备注资、并在两者之间流动 —— 它是回路的燃料，从来不是选票。本白皮书记录架构在公开仓库中的现状，随后规定代币：效用、分配（10% 预售 / 30% IDO / 10% DEX 流动性 / 50% DAO 储备）、两阶段发行、解锁时间表，以及让发行保持公平、让储备保持主权的安全机制。

01 The Sovereignty Loop主权回路

This is one project, not a portfolio of products. Each repository is an organ; the organs share one bloodstream — SPARK. A user chats in Engine; every message burns fuel; fuel is banked in the Aether reserve; the reserve is kept liquid by chartered AI on Havix; Havix's network effects keep Engine alive; and Engine's demand gives SPARK its physical backing. Cut any organ and the loop stops turning. 这是一个项目，不是一个产品组合。每个仓库是一个器官；器官共享同一条血脉 —— SPARK。用户在 Engine 里聊天；每条消息燃烧燃料；燃料沉淀进 Aether 储备；储备由 Havix 上受宪章约束的 AI 维持流动；Havix 的网络效应让 Engine 存活；而 Engine 的需求给 SPARK 以实物支撑。切断任何一个器官，回路即停转。

The metaphors are the architecture: the Keybox never touches the network, the Parliament rules by soulbound SBT, the Brain is licensed, not trusted. Everything below is traceable to public code[1][3][4][6]. 隐喻即架构：钥匙盒永不触网，议会以灵魂绑定 SBT 执政，大脑是被授予执照的，而非被信任的。下文的一切皆可回溯至公开代码[1][3][4][6]。

02 Architecture: Isolation & Identity架构：隔离与身份

2.1 Physical isolation as a security model以物理隔离作为安全模型

The loop's root security decision is separation by physics, not by policy. Engine runs online but holds zero private keys; Vault holds the keys and is built with no network permission at all — its Android manifest declares no INTERNET permission, making exfiltration a physical rather than logical problem[3]. Signing requests travel from Engine to Vault over signature-protected IPC; key material travels between devices only as encrypted QR frames — camera-to-camera, air-gap enforced[3]. 回路的根本安全决策是以物理而非策略实现隔离。Engine 在线运行却不持有任何私钥；Vault 持有密钥，且被构建为完全没有任何网络权限 —— 它的 Android 清单未声明 INTERNET 权限，使数据外泄成为物理问题而非逻辑问题[3]。签名请求经签名保护的 IPC 从 Engine 传至 Vault；密钥材料在设备之间只以加密二维码帧的形式迁移 —— 摄像头对摄像头，强制气隙隔离[3]。

The trust is auditable: Engine's core/ modules (protocol, crypto, IPC) are byte-identical to Vault's, so both apps verify against the same public source[1]. Messages are end-to-end encrypted with ECDH key agreement and AES-256-GCM; the relay sees envelopes, never plaintext[1]. 这种信任是可审计的：Engine 的 core/ 模块（协议、加密、IPC）与 Vault 的逐字节一致，因此两款应用都对照同一份公开源码进行验证[1]。消息以 ECDH 密钥协商与 AES-256-GCM 端到端加密；中继看到的只是信封，从来不是明文[1]。

2.2 One identity, four unlinkable contexts一个身份，四个不可关联的语境

Havix derives four context-specific sub-identities from a single master key using HKDF — public, market, tunnel and wiki contexts[6]. The derivation is cryptographically unlinkable: your market persona cannot be correlated with your private correspondence. This is what lets one person be simultaneously a citizen in the Parliament, a trader in the market, and a private person in chat — without three accounts and without a platform holding the mapping. Havix 用 HKDF 从单一主密钥派生出四个语境专属的子身份 —— 公共、市场、隧道与维基语境[6]。这种派生在密码学上不可关联：你的市场人格无法与你的私人通信被相互对照。正因如此，一个人可以同时是议会里的公民、市场里的交易者、聊天里的私人个体 —— 不需要三个账号，也不存在一个持有映射关系的平台。

2.3 Three planes, one loop三个平面，一条回路

  • Application plane (online): Engine — user-facing, keyless, pure-memory. Messages exist in RAM; the attack surface for seizure is roughly zero.应用平面（在线）：Engine —— 面向用户、无密钥、纯内存。消息只存在于内存中；被查抄的攻击面近乎为零。
  • Custody plane (offline): Vault — keystores sealed behind biometrics, export only via QR.托管平面（离线）：Vault —— 密钥库封于生物识别之后，仅可经二维码导出。
  • Coordination plane (off-chain P2P): Havix — identity derivation, reputation/credit ledgers, arbitration, and the charter that licenses AI stewards[6].协调平面（链下 P2P）：Havix —— 身份派生、信誉/信用账本、仲裁，以及为 AI 管家颁授执照的宪章[6]。
  • Settlement plane (on-chain): Aether on BNB Smart Chain — governance, treasury and timelocked execution, governed by soulbound SBT rank rather than transferable token supply[4][5].结算平面（链上）：BNB Smart Chain 上的 Aether —— 治理、金库与时间锁执行，由灵魂绑定的 SBT 权级而非可转让代币量主导[4][5]。

Havix's own roadmap formalizes this as a three-layer stack — network bedrock (L0), cognitive execution (L1, Germ), on-chain governance (L2, Aether) — with the 4-context DID enforcing the cryptographic separation between layers[7]. Havix 自身的路线图将其形式化为三层栈 —— 网络基座（L0）、认知执行（L1，Germ）、链上治理（L2，Aether）—— 并以四语境 DID 强制层与层之间的密码学隔离[7]。

03 The Four Organs四个器官

3.1 Vault — the KeyboxVault —— 钥匙盒 v3.18.1 · shippedv3.18.1 · 已交付

A generic offline keystore, not an Engine accessory: it can custody keys for any compliant app. Mechanism: no network permission; keystores encrypted at rest; biometric-gated signing (StrongBox-backed where available); dynamic signing codes that prove a signature happened on-device; QR-only migration to new hardware, with the private key never entering a network stack[3]. 一台通用的离线密钥库，而非 Engine 的配件：它可以为任何合规应用托管密钥。机制：无网络权限；密钥库静态加密；生物识别把关的签名（设备支持时由 StrongBox 支撑）；证明签名确在本机发生的动态签名码；仅限二维码的新硬件迁移 —— 私钥从不进入任何网络栈[3]。

3.2 Engine — the AppEngine —— 应用 v3.22 · shippedv3.22 · 已交付

The market entry point of the whole loop: a sovereign social messenger with pure-memory architecture, group messaging, a 60-emoji expression economy and DID profiles[1]. Its economic engine is already specified in the repository: one kilobyte costs ten SPARK — every message is metered by its UTF-8 size, rounded up, with a floor of ten SPARK per message; each device receives a one-time activation grant of 1,000 SPARK the first time Engine and Vault are paired (once per device, for life — regenerating key pairs does not re-grant); heavy users top up from a wallet[2]. Client-side pre-deduction is implemented; a standalone spark-ledger service settles balances server-side[2]. 整条回路的市场入口：一个具备纯内存架构、群组消息、60 张表情经济与 DID 档案的主权社交通讯应用[1]。它的经济引擎已在仓库中成文：每一 KB 花费十枚 SPARK —— 每条消息按其 UTF-8 字节数计量、向上取整、单条最低十枚；每台设备在首次配对 Engine 与 Vault 时获得一次性激活赠金 1,000 SPARK（设备终生仅一次 —— 重新生成密钥对也不再发放）；重度用户从钱包充值[2]。客户端预扣已实现；独立的 spark-ledger 服务在服务端结算余额[2]。

3.3 Aether — the ParliamentAether —— 议会 v3.4 audited · mainnet pendingv3.4 已审计 · 待主网

An SBT-governed DAO kernel on BNB Smart Chain. Weight is earned, not bought: AetherRing mints 14 non-transferable soulbound ranks; three chambers (Council, Parliament, Elders) plus a citizen referendum check one another through a 7-stage proposal lifecycle with an elder veto; the treasury is a 3/5 Safe multisig executing timelocked calls[4][5]. The deliberate design tension: governance is soulbound (SBT) while the fuel is a real, issued asset — whales can buy $SPARK, but $SPARK buys messages, not votes. One contract stands apart: AetherDonation is an external philanthropy channel (USDC tips for public goods) and is independent of the loop's economics. BNB Smart Chain 上的 SBT 治理 DAO 内核。权重靠挣得，而非买得：AetherRing 铸造 14 级不可转让的灵魂绑定权级；三院（理事会、议院、元老院）外加公民公投，经由带元老否决的七阶段提案生命周期相互制衡；金库是执行时间锁调用的 3/5 Safe 多签[4][5]。刻意的设计张力在于：治理是灵魂绑定的（SBT），而燃料是真实发行的资产 —— 巨鲸买得起 $SPARK，但 $SPARK 买到的是消息，不是选票。有一个合约置身局外：AetherDonation 是外部慈善通道（面向公共物品的 USDC 打赏），与回路经济相互独立。

3.4 Havix — the BedrockHavix —— 基座 M10 · closed betaM10 · 封闭内测

The P2P overlay where the loop's coordination happens: eight modules (identity, message-types, credit, vouch, wiki, arbitration, market, s-node runtime), 1,234 passing tests, and a security audit that closed all 15 findings[6]. Its charter plane is what makes AI stewardship legal rather than magical: routine operations execute automatically with receipts; red-line operations are physically routed to a human, on-chain vote. The charter store and interceptor are scheduled as the M11 workstream[7]. 回路协调发生的 P2P 覆盖网络：八个模块（身份、消息类型、信用、担保、维基、仲裁、市场、s-node 运行时）、1,234 项通过的测试、以及一项关闭全部 15 项发现的安全审计[6]。它的宪章面让 AI 管家合法而非魔法：例行操作自动执行并留回执；红线操作被物理地路由至人类的链上表决。宪章存储与拦截器排定为 M11 工作流[7]。

3.5 Germ — the Brain, laterGerm —— 大脑，远期

Germ is the node-level AI layer: stewards that reason with their own 4-context identities on the substrate. It is intentionally deferred — Engine is today's market entry; the Brain arrives when the loop has users worth stewarding. In this whitepaper Germ appears only where the economics must reserve room for it (reserve stewardship, §5). Germ 是节点级 AI 层：在基座上以自身四语境身份进行推理的管家。它被有意延后 —— Engine 才是今天的市场入口；等回路拥有值得照料的用户时，大脑才会到来。在本白皮书中，Germ 只在经济必须为它预留空间之处出现（储备管家，§5）。

04 SPARK Token EconomicsSPARK 代币经济学

4.1 Utility: fuel with physics behind it效用：背后有物理的燃料

SPARK is a metering asset. In Engine, every kilobyte costs 10 SPARK — metered by message size, rounded up, minimum 10 per message — the meter is in the protocol, not the terms of service[2]. Budgets derive from a real 100 Mbps relay baseline: text envelopes up to 40 KB, media up to 48 KB, a 128 KB hard frame ceiling, groups capped at 200[1]. Because every expressive byte costs fuel, spam has a marginal cost and speech stays free. SPARK 是计量资产。在 Engine 中，每 KB 花费 10 SPARK —— 按消息大小计量、向上取整、单条最低 10 —— 计量器长在协议里，而不是服务条款里[2]。预算源自真实的 100 Mbps 中继基线：文本信封至多 40 KB、媒体至多 48 KB、128 KB 的硬性帧上限、群组上限 200 人[1]。因为每一个表达的字节都要花燃料，垃圾信息有了边际成本，而言论保持自由。

  • Acquire: one-time activation grant (1,000 SPARK the first time Engine and Vault are paired on a device — once per device, for life[2]), wallet top-up[2], or market purchase after TGE.获取：一次性激活赠金（设备首次配对 Engine 与 Vault 时发放 1,000 SPARK —— 每台设备终生仅一次[2]）、钱包充值[2]、或 TGE 后市场购买。
  • Spend: messaging fuel; group and media budgets; SDK app usage.消耗：消息燃料；群组与媒体预算；SDK 应用使用。
  • Hold: the DAO treasury holds SPARK as its long-term reserve — demand from real usage accrues to every holder symmetrically.持有：DAO 金库将 SPARK 作为长期储备持有 —— 真实用量带来的需求对称地累积到每一位持有者身上。

◇ Design parameters (vesting lengths, LP lock, fee routing, allowance decay) are recommended defaults of this draft; each is confirmed or amended by governance before the presale opens. On-chain metering rates (1 KB = 10 SPARK, minimum 10 per message; 1,000 one-time activation grant per device) are fixed in the Engine specification[2]. ◇ 设计参数（锁仓时长、LP 锁定、费用路由、配额衰减）为本草案的推荐默认值；每一项都会在预售开启前由治理确认或修订。链上计量费率（1 KB = 10 SPARK，单条最低 10；每设备一次性激活赠金 1,000）固定于 Engine 规格中[2]。

4.2 Supply & allocation供给与分配

Total supply is fixed at 1,000T SPARK (1,000,000,000,000,000 — one thousand trillion). Allocation follows the 10 / 30 / 10 / 50 split: presale, IDO, DEX liquidity, DAO reserve. There is no team tranche, no insider allocation, no marketing tranche — the team's upside is the 50% reserve it shares with the DAO, unlocked only through public governance. 总供给固定为 1000 万亿枚 SPARK（1,000,000,000,000,000）。分配遵循 10 / 30 / 10 / 50 的切分：预售、IDO、DEX 流动性、DAO 储备。没有团队份额，没有内部人配售，没有营销份额 —— 团队的上行空间就是它与 DAO 共享的那 50% 储备，且只能经公开治理解锁。

04b The Dual-Track Launch双轨发行

The core of the launch is presale + IDO in parallel, at different tempos: the presale targets the core community; the IDO faces the public. The presale builds the base; the IDO opens the market. 发行的核心是预售与 IDO 双轨并行、节奏不同：预售面向核心社区；IDO 面向公众。预售建立基本盘；IDO 引爆市场。

4.3 Phase 1 — Presale (10%)阶段一 —— 预售（10%）

  • Audience: early core contributors and active community members only. Wallet addresses are collected into a whitelist in advance; start time is announced to the list first.对象：仅限早期核心贡献者与活跃社区成员。钱包地址提前收集进白名单；开始时间优先通知名单成员。
  • Anti-whale: a hard $500 per-wallet cap.防巨鲸：硬性每钱包 $500 上限。
  • Terms: pay with USDT or BNB at a fixed low price; 20% unlocks at TGE, the remainder vests linearly over 6 months ◇.条款：以 USDT 或 BNB 按固定低价认购；TGE 时解锁 20%，其余在 6 个月内线性释放 ◇。
  • Execution: when the window opens, whitelisted wallets connect on the official site and subscribe inside the cap.执行：窗口开启后，白名单钱包在官网连接并在限额内认购。

4.4 Phase 2 — IDO (30%)阶段二 —— IDO（30%）

  • Platform: an LBP launchpad of the Fjord Foundry class — the price starts high and decays until demand catches it, which removes the sniping edge; no whitelist, no first-block advantage.平台：Fjord Foundry 一类的 LBP 发射台 —— 价格由高走低，直至需求接住它，这消除了抢跑优势；没有白名单，没有首块优势。
  • Parameters: token address triple-checked before funding the pool (irreversible); payment in USDT or BNB; a 3–7 day window; per-wallet minimum and maximum caps; starting price above the presale price.参数：向资金池注资前反复核对代币地址（不可逆）；以 USDT 或 BNB 支付；窗口期 3–7 天；每钱包设最小/最大限额；起始价略高于预售价。
  • Distribution: "distribute at end" mode — one uniform claim/airdrop at TGE; proceeds flow directly to the project multisig.发放："结束后发放"模式 —— TGE 时统一领取/空投；认购资金直接进入项目多签钱包。
  • Accounting: after the window closes, the subscription list and amounts are reconciled and published before distribution.核算：窗口关闭后，认购名单与金额经核对并在分发前公示。

4.5 Liquidity & DEX (10%)流动性与 DEX（10%）

At TGE the liquidity tranche seeds the DEX pool, paired against BNB. SPARK is recommended to issue as a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain ◇ — matching the USDT/BNB payment rails of both rounds — with the Aether treasury and governance deployed on the same BNB Smart Chain[4], so reserve operations settle natively with no cross-chain bridge[5]. TGE 时，流动性份额注入 DEX 资金池，与 BNB 配对。SPARK 建议以 BEP-20 形式发行于 BNB Chain ◇ —— 与两轮认购的 USDT/BNB 支付轨道相匹配 —— Aether 金库与治理同链部署于 BNB Smart Chain[4]，储备操作原生结算，无需跨链桥[5]。

4.6 Unlock schedule解锁时间表

The structural promise is a hard float ceiling of 50%: no calendar ever unlocks the reserve — only a public, vetoable proposal can. Early buyers know exactly what the maximum float is. 结构性承诺是50% 的流通量硬上限：任何日历都不会解锁储备 —— 只有公开的、可否决的提案可以。早期买家清楚地知道最大流通量是多少。

4.7 Safeguards & compliance安全机制与合规

  • Security: token, presale and LBP contracts must carry audits from a recognized firm before any funds are accepted; reports are published alongside the addresses.安全：代币、预售与 LBP 合约在接收任何资金之前必须经知名机构审计；审计报告随地址一并公示。
  • Transparency: presale and IDO contract addresses and rules are announced before each window opens; the subscription reconciliation is published before TGE distribution.透明：预售与 IDO 的合约地址和规则在各自窗口开启前公告；认购对账在 TGE 分发前公示。
  • Anti-bot: LBP price decay defeats sniping; per-wallet caps ($500 presale; min/max IDO) cap concentration; dynamic slippage bounds may be applied on the presale contract ◇.防机器人：LBP 价格衰减击败抢跑；每钱包限额（预售 $500；IDO 最小/最大）抑制集中度；预售合约可加动态滑点边界 ◇。
  • Legal: the launch is being reviewed by counsel for the jurisdictions involved; participation may be restricted where required. Nothing here is an offer of securities.法律：发行正由相关司法辖区的律师审阅；必要时可能限制参与。本文任何内容均不构成证券要约。

05 Governance of the Reserve储备的治理

The 50% reserve is not a treasury wallet — it is a constitutional object. Custody sits in a 3/5 Safe multisig; every movement requires a proposal through Aether's 7-stage lifecycle, survives the elder veto window, and executes through the timelock[4][5]. Weight in that process is soulbound and earned — 14 AetherRing ranks that cannot be bought or transferred[4]. 50% 的储备不是一个金库钱包 —— 它是一个宪法意义上的对象。托管于 3/5 Safe 多签；每一次动用都须经历 Aether 七阶段生命周期的提案、挺过元老否决窗口、并经时间锁执行[4][5]。这一过程中的权重是灵魂绑定且挣得的 —— 14 级 AetherRing 权级，买不到也转不走[4]。

Reserve uses are bounded by charter: user-subsidy epochs for Engine fuel, relay and infrastructure funding, ecosystem grants, and — once Germ exists — liquidity stewardship by chartered AI inside hard limits, with red lines routing back to human votes[6][7]. The balance design is deliberate: chambers and citizens each hold roughly half the voting weight, so neither the institution nor the crowd can spend the reserve alone[5]. 储备的用途受宪章约束：Engine 燃料的用户补贴期、中继与基础设施经费、生态资助，以及 —— 待 Germ 存在之后 —— 受宪章 AI 在硬性限额之内的流动性管家，红线一律路由回人类表决[6][7]。制衡设计是刻意的：议席与公民各持约半数表决权重，机构与群众都无法单独花掉储备[5]。

07 Risks & Disclaimers风险与免责声明

  • Execution risk: Aether mainnet deployment, the M11 charter store, and the spark-ledger service are unfinished components the TGE sequence depends on[2][7].执行风险：Aether 主网部署、M11 宪章存储与 spark-ledger 服务是 TGE 流程所依赖的未完成组件[2][7]。
  • Cross-chain risk: mitigated by design — SPARK and the Aether governance/treasury deploy on the same BNB Smart Chain ◇, so reserve operations settle natively without any bridge dependency.跨链风险：已从设计上消除 —— SPARK 与 Aether 治理/金库同链部署于 BNB Smart Chain ◇，储备操作原生结算，不引入任何桥依赖。
  • Market risk: an LBP discovers price honestly — which means it can discover it downward. Fixed low presale pricing compensates early trust but does not guarantee returns.市场风险：LBP 诚实地发现价格 —— 这也意味着它可能向下发现。预售固定低价补偿早期信任，但不保证回报。
  • Regulatory risk: token launches face divergent regulation; restrictions may apply by jurisdiction; counsel review is a precondition, not a formality.监管风险：代币发行面临分化的监管；不同司法辖区可能适用限制；律师审阅是前置条件，不是走过场。
  • Smart-contract risk: audits reduce but never eliminate risk; only interact with addresses published on the official site.智能合约风险：审计降低但不消除风险；只与官网公示的地址交互。
